item.title: Gunnar: en let, selvhostet git-server til jeres egen hardware
item.description: Gunnar er en let, selvhostet git-server i Rust til on-prem: to kommandoer at installere, air-gapped som standard, krypterede repositories og åben kildekode.
item.author: Rickard

item.title: Gunnar is live: a lightweight self-hosted git server for your own hardware
item.description: Gunnar is a lightweight, self-hosted git server in Rust for on-prem use: two commands to install, airgap by default, encrypted repos. Now live on gunnar.rs.
item.author: Rickard

item.title: Gunnar: a git server with no database, no shell and no OS
item.description: A git server in Rust that spawns nothing, stores no database, and boots as PID 1 on a 29.5 MB ISO. Stock git is both client and test judge.
item.author: Rickard

item.title: Korp: one app over the whole data path, and a UI robots can read
item.description: Spark pipelines, a live graph, time-travelling Iceberg tables and maps in one Rust app whose entire UI state dumps to JSON, so tests need no display.
item.author: Rickard

item.title: tunnr: a distroless WireGuard appliance that boots tunnel-first
item.description: A bare-metal WireGuard appliance in Rust: no shell, no package manager, one binary as PID 1, and the tunnel up before any other packet leaves.
item.author: Henrik
